method.design: Live LLM semantic judge on production read/brew seams; seed/yang/coda anchors independently selectable; no free-text regex; structured pass/fail only.

limitations: Semantic judge is one configured model; not population calibration.
Anchor ③ structural + restore are CI pytest only (no live LLM required).
Yang three-beat uses production write/read seams with fixture beats; full multi-month live summon chain is optional extension.
Coda semantic is optional per r2; mechanical prior_events locked by pytest.
